_comment: Dictionnaire de traduction des graphiques pour le Substack anglais. Les valeurs ne changent jamais — seuls les libellés. `forbid` liste des mots français qui, s'ils survivent, font échouer le rendu plutôt que de laisser passer une légende à moitié traduite.

reactionChart.title: Oracle's last eight reports, against what the market is charging now
reactionChart.note: Absolute move of each reaction, measured from the session before the announcement to the session after. The dashed line is Thursday's implied move. Green bars stayed below it, red ones cleared it — and the tallest one alone wipes out every gain the others made.

sectorChart.title: Eleven US sectors, week and month
sectorChart.note: Light bars are the week, dark bars the month. A sector can lead the week and still lag over the month — technology does exactly that.

volChart.title: The implied volatility curve, shortest to longest
volChart.note: The cheapest point on the curve is the nine-day window — the one holding this week's appointments.

leadPathChart.title: Oracle over recent sessions
leadPathChart.note: The shaded band is the three-session run everyone will quote. It starts from the stock's lowest close of the month — that starting point, not the path, is what produces the big number.

chainChart.title: The infrastructure chain over twenty-one sessions
chainChart.note: Nine up, three down. Two of the three decliners never reported: filing results is not what separates them.

precChart.title: Where Broadcom's month actually came from
precChart.note: The report explains only a fraction of the month. Blaming the whole of it on the event is a reversal of cause and effect, and it can be measured.

intradayChart.title: Across the last eight reactions, the open was the low of the day
intradayChart.note: Each point plots the opening gap (horizontal) against what the session did afterwards (vertical). Almost all sit above zero, including the negative reactions: selling at the opening bell has been the wrong reflex on this stock.

cryptoChart.title: Crypto: the month against the week
cryptoChart.note: A very strong month, a far calmer week. It is the slowdown, not the rally, that should drive the sizing decision.
